name: k3y69b-haiku-tool-churn
goal: Haiku module workers stop rotating at startup when claude.ai connector tools load mid-session; context limits stay enforced

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Session telemetry from four failed workers and the 16:2x replay: first request 26.8k all cache read, next 120.8k all cache write (tool prefix changed), then refusal at about 196k. Expected: connector tools do not join a module worker, and a changed tool list is not recharged in full.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The provider-session relay case sent only messages, never tools, and no test pinned the worker's MCP isolation; a single-turn CLI probe finishes before connectors load. New provider-request-gate tests cover tools appearing and changing mid-session, an oversized tool set, and the worker command.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: ae7fb6a12f: both new tests fail (gate forwards 2 of 3 safe requests; command lacks --strict-mcp-config).

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: d4e4b55568: Claude worker command adds --strict-mcp-config; the gate fingerprints each tool and counts only new or changed definitions. Hard limit unchanged.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: d4e4b55568: unchanged tests pass (loop record green).

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
